title: This fan packs a whirlwind!
text: This fan packs a whirlwind!. I am very impressed by how much wind this fan can put out! It’s the strongest handheld fan I’ve ever had!!

product_metadata.title: CUBEPER Handheld Fan Portable Mini Hand Held Fan with 3 Speeds USB Fan Battery Operated Fans Hand Held 2-5 Hours Operation Base Personal Mini Fan for Home Travel Office Outdoor
features: Handheld Fan: Handheld turbo fan with new brushless motor design, air turbine and air injection. The airflow is accelerated and compressed by the wind pipe turbine, the wind force is stronger, and the wind feeling is closer to nature.

Portable Handheld Fan: Provides intense cooling.Super wind 3-speed fan, you only need to press the power button to change the wind speed setting Press once for low speed 5000r/min Press twice for medium speed 7000r/min Press three times for high speed 9000r/min The wind speed is strong enough to cool you down quickly

Mini Handheld Fan: Comes with a rechargeable battery that provides 2-5 hours of duration (depending on different speeds). You can charge it through a regular socket, power bank, computer or any other device with a USB port, it takes 2 hours to fully charge, and it comes with a Type-C charging cable.

Pocket Fan: Personal fan handheld only 142*50*43mm (5.6*1.9*1.7 inches) 108g (3.8 oz) The personal mini fan has passed FCC, CE, ROHS and other certifications.If you have any questions about this personal mini fan, please contact us first, we will solve it for you within 24 hours

Great gift for summer: Lightweight and portable mini handheld fan, the overall design is simple, you can put it in your pocket or bag, and take it with you when queuing or exercising in such a hot summer, it is a perfect companion, allowing you to travel keep cool boys men women and kids
